lines.dialogue: We need your help Star Fox!
And is trying to take over Corneria!
Our army alone can't do the job!
This is Peppy all systems go!
You got an enemy on your tail!
I could use some help here Fox!
Somethin' is wrong with the G-Diffuser!
Things are starting to heat up!
We're heading in to the asteroids!
I guess it's your turn to be thankful!
You want a piece of me!
I cannot allow you to go any further...
That shield is absorbing the laser!
Are you going to listen to that mo...(audio break).
I can;t believe I lost to this!
You're more cunning than I thought!
I think you look better in a tank!
He can sure be a pain in the neck!
Why don't you come down here Falco!?
Enemy fighters coming at you Fox!
Let me get a piece of that action Fox!
Slippy what are you doing? Hurry up!
Sure you can handle it Fox?
Let's take out that weapon boys!
We're getting close to the base.
I can't wait to see this secret weapon!
Take it easy Fox don't let us down!
I'm going ahead, back me up Fox!
So this is the secret weapon!

lines.notes: Let's sneak in low and surprise them Falcocomms

lines.dialogue: I can't believe they did this.
We're closing in on them Falco!
Is that any way to greet a girl?
Take the right one boy, I have the left!
I've got somebody on my tail!
Mess with me, and you'll get scratched!
Be careful it might be a trap!
Something is coming from the sea!
His armour is tough use..(cuts off).
Looks like we're headed for Macbeth!
We're gonna break through that fleet!
Shoot'em down with B and R!
They're on me, I'm getting killed!
Shoot the tentacles to open the core!
The shield is down shoot the door!
Let's hold it threough the first line!
These guys just don't give up!
The last line has been breached!
Time to show the monkeys who's boss!
This brings back memories of your dad!
Don't go dying on me Fox!
Geez Louise what the heck happened?
That temple gives me the creeps.
What's going on he's running away!
It's all coming down to this!
I gota bad feeling about this Fox!
I'll go at it alone from here!
I've been wiating for you Star Fox...
You know that I control the galaxy...
It's foolish to come against me!
You will die just like your father.
Fox get this guy off me!
Take care of the guy behind me Fox!
What's taking you so long Fox!
Gee I've been save by Fox!
Your father helped me like that too!
You're not getting away that easy!
I won;t let you get away from me!
Can't let you do that StarFox!
Andross has ordered us to take you down!
We're getting payed a lot of cash to take you down!
Keep an eye on your shield gauge!
The Arwing might not make it!
This baby can take temperatures up to 9000 degrees.
Looks like you could use some help Fox!
This is the enemy's bio weapon?
Don't fly too low your ship can't take it!
I think I'll torture you for a while!
James screamed real good! Before he died!
You'll be sorry you crossed us!
Good! I see the enemy core!
You are not getting away with this!
Somebody's gonna pay for all this!
Don't let any of them get through!
Hold on they're trying to get through!
Is that the best you can do!
I'll take care of everything from below!
Don't let him get to the supply depo!
I see the fuel bunker on the right side!
Shoot the 8 switches to open the lock!
Well at least we could take this boss out!
I'm sure we heard of this one!
Now it's our turn to kick some tail!
I can see the look on their stupid faces!
Here come the little hyenas now!
I'll lure these guys to the front!
I didn't expect to have to ask you this here!
Heh heh heh, what's wrong Starfox!
We can catch up later Fox!
Time to tell the good guys!
Try shooting the bad guys Fox!
Man there's just no end to these guys!
Go for the under hatches and fire!
There's some sort of energy reaction!
Hurry up and take out that door!
Let's see how you handle our new ships.
Too bad your father's not here!
We'll make sure you never reach Andross!
We'll just see about that Star Wolf.
Now you will feel true pain!
If I go down I;m taking you with me!
I'm gonna bust you up real good!
I see you got new ships.
I've taken a few hits but I'm ok!
I though I was a gonner!
I saw my life flash before my eyes!
You worry about your own hide!
You tryin to damadge my pretty face!
What do you think you're doing!
Aww man I'm gonna have to back up.
Alrigth I gotta sit this one out!
If I don't leave I'm gonna be Monkey food!
We are in your debt Star Fox!
Honored to be at your service.
It's time for us to go now.
